remarks: Nicely finished half duplex offering a double attached garage with floor drain, separate side entry, and 9’ ceilings on both the main and basement levels. The open-concept main floor features durable LVP flooring, a welcoming foyer with coat closet, and a convenient 2-piece bath.   The kitchen is designed for style and function with quartz countertops, a corner pantry, island with flush eating ledge, Silgranit undermount sink, built-in microwave, pendant lighting, a chimney-style hood fan, a full-height backsplash, and upgraded soft-close cabinetry.   The bright great room and dining nook are filled with natural light from large windows and a patio door leading to the future deck and backyard. Upstairs includes a bonus room, laundry area, full bath, and two spacious bedrooms. The primary suite offers a walk-in closet and a 3-piece ensuite.  Finished with black fixtures and basement rough-in plumbing. (id:67522)
